description: Phase W4 runtime snapshot shape for world/data/runtime/portfolio.json. Presentation-only reflection of portfolio state - not the source of truth (that remains the trading engine's own portfolio/ module, which this schema never reads from or writes to).

district.description: Always portfolio-garden in the current district map.

sizeLabel.description: Free-text display label, e.g. 'small'/'medium'/'large' - deliberately not a raw notional amount, to keep this a presentation-only reflection.
